datasets.title: Central Asia hydraulic defenses protection level (SFRARR)
datasets.description: Hydraulic defenses protection level (years) for the river stretches of Central Asia that belong to an urban agglomerate.
datasets.purpose: Regional risk modelling. These data have been derived on a regional scale for the purpose of consistent regional multi-country hazard and risk assessment. Application of this information on smaller scales should be done with care. Importantly on a local scale, it is often the case that more detailed history and hazard information is required to perform such hazard and risk modelling, particularly where applied to dimension mitigation structures or strategies.

project.name: SFRARR - Strengthening Financial Resilience and Accelerating Risk Reduction in Central Asia

datasets.details: Data from the EU-funded 'Strengthening Financial Resilience and Accelerating Risk Reduction in Central Asia' Program (https://www.gfdrr.org/en/program/SFRARR-Central-Asia). Hydraulic defenses protection level (years) calculated for each Central Asia river portion afferent to a urban agglomerate. The hydraulic protection level of each river tract was derived based on the correlation between the available hydraulic protection data and the protected exposure using the population density of the corresponding urban agglomerate as a proxy of the exposure. The estimated correlation was then linearly scaled using the area protection standards provided by the FLOPROS database.
